scheme_name: AICTE-IDEA (Idea Development, Evaluation & Application) LAB SCHEME
other_conditions: AICTE‑approved engineering colleges or university departments must have been in existence for at least 10 years
The institution must have at least one course with live NBA accreditation
The institution must contribute financially at least 50% of the IDEA Lab cost, with higher weightage for additional industry funds
The institution must provide a built‑up and furnished space of at least 3000 sq. ft. for the lab
The institution must provide all support staff, facilities and amenities required to operate and maintain the lab
The institution must comply with AICTE guidelines and other Government of India rules pertaining to the IDEA Lab
benefits_summary: AICTE provides up to 50 % financial assistance (up to ₹55,00,000) and training for faculty and students to develop ideas into prototypes.
